retryableStages.description: Which stages can be retried (default: collect only)
retryableStages.title: Retryablestages

requireIdempotent.description: Only retry if operation is marked idempotent
requireIdempotent.title: Requireidempotent

TaskKind.description:
Task kind determines collect behavior.

- SELECTION: Normal collect; empty selection → early-return (default)
- CREATION: Skip collect; items=[]; compute/apply must handle empty input
TaskKind.title: TaskKind

mode.description: 'apply' executes the batch. 'validate' checks operation contracts without invoking handlers or changing document state on the default structured SOC route; it is not applied to custom callbacks.
mode.title: Mode

stopOnError.description: Stop the default structured SOC batch after the first failed operation. Custom callback pipelines do not consume this option.
stopOnError.title: Stoponerror

kind.description: Callback-pipeline collection mode: 'selection' collects items and 'creation' skips collection. The default SOC executor forces creation.

skipCollect.description: Low-level callback-pipeline control that skips collection; kind='creation' implies it. The default SOC executor already skips collection.
skipCollect.title: Skipcollect

minCreated.description: Callback-pipeline safety rail checked after apply; warns when the reported modified count is below this value. Not applied to the default SOC route, whose apply callback is absent.
minCreated.title: Mincreated

dryRun.description: NOT SUPPORTED (T03). Setting this rejects the request before execution. It formerly claimed 'no changes applied' while batch operations had already mutated the document during the compute stage. Use a read-only tool to inspect state instead.
dryRun.title: Dryrun

idPolicy.description: ID assignment policy used during the callback pipeline's collect stage. The default SOC route skips that outer collection.

assignIds.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for opt-in ID assignment during the callback pipeline's collect stage. Prefer idPolicy='opt_in'.
assignIds.title: Assignids

timeout.description: Compatibility field retained and validated, but not currently used as illustrator_execute_task's host deadline.
timeout.title: Timeout

retry.description: Compatibility field retained and validated, but currently ignored: illustrator_execute_task does not call the retry wrapper.

idempotency.description: Compatibility field retained for retry metadata, but currently ignored because illustrator_execute_task does not call the retry wrapper.

rollback.description: Unsupported recovery request; true is rejected before dispatch. False and null are accepted as disabled compatibility forms.
rollback.title: Rollback

snapshot.description: Unsupported recovery request; true is rejected before dispatch. False and null are accepted as disabled compatibility forms.
snapshot.title: Snapshot

recompute.description: Unsupported destructive replay request; any enabled request is rejected.
recompute.title: Recompute
